statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-50526 (GHSA-55jh-fwmh-39m4) is a tampering issue in the .NET SDK container image build (Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers): improper link resolution lets a local attacker inject resources that can be incorporated into container images built by other users on the same machine. Microsoft lists Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers as affected from 10.0.0 through the .NET 10.0.9 release and fixed in the .NET 10.0.10 release, which ships .NET SDK 10.0.110 and 10.0.302 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-55jh-fwmh-39m4, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/415, https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/issues/55274, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.10/10.0.10.md). The fix moves the blob cache to a per-user directory and validates the digest of downloaded and cached blobs; on the release/10.0.1xx branch of the .NET source repository it is https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/commit/c3dd5c545c0bdfdb64c9934fbf489662d49cc7a2 and https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/commit/85e2b07328981fbd0b75ab75ab83536970a6e5fb, first in the v10.0.110 source release. DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0 through 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers.dll is in two places in each build on each architecture: the Containers tasks of the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, and the Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers nupkg in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts. Both carry the SDK version that matches the build (SDK 10.0.102 in 10.0.2-r0 up to SDK 10.0.115 in 10.0.15-r0). Extracted every copy and checked it for the digest-checking blob copy routine (CopyToAndVerifyAsync) and the "Digest validation failed for cached blob" message that the fix adds. The copies in the first 8 builds (10.0.2-r0 to 10.0.9-r0, SDK 10.0.102 to 10.0.109) lack both; every copy from 10.0.10-r0 on (SDK 10.0.110 and later) contains both. The range ends at 10.0.10-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-50526 (GHSA-55jh-fwmh-39m4) is a tampering issue in the .NET SDK container image build (Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers): improper link resolution lets a local attacker inject resources that can be incorporated into container images built by other users on the same machine. Microsoft lists Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers as affected through the .NET 8.0.28 release and fixed in the .NET 8.0.29 release, which ships .NET SDK 8.0.129 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-55jh-fwmh-39m4, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/415, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.29/8.0.29.md). In the .NET 8.0.1xx SDK the fix moves the blob cache to a per-user directory and validates the digest of downloaded and cached blobs (https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/commit/72582fe4753ae0fb17fd022cb97cc83bff878619, https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/commit/f98d101aaa61e2e8a8f85dbbd9442283c02a1203). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers.dll is in two places in each build: the Containers tasks of the .NET SDK held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap, and the Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers nupkg in dotnet8-runtime-artifacts. Both carry the SDK version that matches the build (SDK 8.0.123 in 8.0.23-r0 up to SDK 8.0.134 in 8.0.34-r0). All 40 copies were checked: the copies in the first five builds (8.0.23-r0 to 8.0.27-r0, SDK 8.0.127 or earlier) lack the cache digest validation, and every copy from 8.0.29-r0 on (SDK 8.0.129 and later) contains the digest-checking blob copy routine (CopyToAndVerifyAsync), the InvalidDigestException type and the "Digest validation failed for cached blob" message that the fix adds. No 8.0.28 build was published; the build after 8.0.27-r0 is 8.0.29-r0. The range ends at 8.0.29-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
